defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a magic hit so the damage is absorbed and turned into Runic Power.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the group for a stacked magic hit that the raid has to eat.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for the heaviest physical hit in the window, and use it to shrug off a stun.

defensives.name: Vampiric Blood
defensives.usage_rule: Press it whenever it is not already up so your Death Strikes land on a bigger health pool and heal for more.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to break or ignore a charm, fear, or sleep effect.

defensives.name: Rune Tap
defensives.usage_rule: Weave a charge into predictable melee swings and do not sit on both charges.

defensives.name: Tombstone
defensives.usage_rule: Cash in surplus Bone Shield charges for the absorb only when you are already deep into your bones.

defensives.name: Sacrificial Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Sacrifice the ghoul for an emergency heal when your other defensives are down.
